scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Unlock SFX + All Other Visuals, Hitbox Exp.+More
scripts.features:
This Fishy Hub script for Volleyball Legends uses FishyUI and opens with RightShift, offering a menu for visual and gameplay adjustments. Most tabs are client-side only, letting you preview or apply score effects, ball skins, emotes, jerseys, player cards, nametags, auras, styles, win screens, lighting, and performance modes without saving to the server. The Gameplay tab changes what your client sends on ball contact, including hitbox expansion, pinned Super Spike charge, spike aiming, and automatic jump/spike timing. It hooks the game’s own modules and remotes where possible, restoring original functions on unload and reverting visual changes when disabled or when you leave. A learning spike-aim system records what was sent, the resulting ball velocity, and landing spots, saving samples to a local JSON file for per-style, serve/rally, and Super Spike adjustments. Inventory tools can visually fill the game’s menu and route local equips to matching visual tabs, while nametag and chat title changes are locally editable and reversible. Performance levels progressively disable shadows, particles, lights, textures, and other rendering features, with an FPS cap and optional paused 3D rendering for AFK use. It includes helper utilities like a ball showroom, emote dummies, pack openings, rank animations, level-up effects, freecam, and config/theme saving through FishyUI.

local API_URL = "https://milkykey.onrender.com"
local DISCORD_URL = "https://discord.gg/dZwE6aMnZC"

local function checkWhitelist()
    local url = API_URL .. "/check?user=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(LocalPlayer.Name)
    local success, result = pcall(function()
        local response = HttpService:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet(url))
        return response
    end)

    if success and result then
        return result.allowed
    end

    return false
end

    automationsTab:CreateToggle({
        Name = "🎰 Lucky Spins",
        CurrentValue = false,

            _G.L = state
            task.spawn(function()
                while _G.L do
                    if remoteExists and seasonRemote then
                        pcall(function()
                            seasonRemote:InvokeServer(1)
                        end)
                    end
                    task.wait(0.5)
                end
            end)
        end
    })

    automationsTab:CreateToggle({
        Name = "💰 Auto Yen",
        CurrentValue = false,
        Flag = "Toggle_Yen",
        Callback = function(state)
            _G.Y = state
            task.spawn(function()

                    if remoteExists and seasonRemote then
                        pcall(function()
                            seasonRemote:InvokeServer(2)
                        end)
                    end
                    task.wait(0.6)
                end
            end)
        end
    })

    automationsTab:CreateToggle({
        Name = "⚡ Auto Habilidades",
        CurrentValue = false,
        Flag = "Toggle_Skills",
        Callback = function(state)
            _G.H = state
            task.spawn(function()
                while _G.H do
                    if remoteExists and seasonRemote then
                        pcall(function()
                            seasonRemote:InvokeServer(4)

    loadHub()
else

        StatusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
        StatusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium

        StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 0)

        CopyButton.Parent = Frame

        CopyButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        CopyButton.Text = "📋 COPY DISCORD LINK"
        CopyButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        CopyButton.TextSize = 13

        ButtonUICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        ButtonUICorner.Parent = CopyButton

        ButtonUIStroke.Parent = CopyButton
        ButtonUIStroke.Thickness = 1
        ButtonUIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 80)

        CopyButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(CopyButton, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
            }):Play()
        end)

        CopyButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(CopyButton, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 32)
            }):Play()
        end)

        CopyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if setclipboard then
                setclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
                CopyButton.Text = "✅ DISCORD LINK COPIED!"
                CopyButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 150)
                task.wait(2.5)
                CopyButton.Text = "📋 COPY DISCORD LINK"
                CopyButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                return
            end
            CopyButton.Text = DISCORD_URL
        end)

        task.spawn(function()
            repeat
                task.wait(3)
            until checkWhitelist()

            StatusLabel.Text = "⚡ Verification Detected! Loading..."
            StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 150)
            task.wait(1)
            ScreenGui:Destroy()
            loadHub()
        end)
    end)()
end

scripts.features:
BARRAGE - Volleyball Legends
v3.5 Update Log
GAMEPLAY
Auto Spike & Shot Modes
Auto Spike: Automatically spikes when airborne and ball is in reach. Includes a Panic Spike mode that ignores normal gates near the floor.

Spike Conditions: Configurable gates: Above Net, Above You, Ball Approaching, Block Priority, In Front, Minimum Distance, Peak Timing.

Smart Aim (Premium): 14x10 grid targeting enemy court gaps. Accounts for enemy velocity, net threat scaling, block power, and vine wall path blocking.

Silent Aim & Tilt: Silent Aim faces camera direction on jump for manual control. Spike Tilt automatically tilts W/A/S/D mid-air toward targets.

Smart Jump (Premium): Jumps only when ball peaks/falls in reach. Delays: Fastest, Fast, Default, Slow, Slowest.

Glide Magnet: Airborne tracking toward the ball. Legit mode stops on contact; Blatant tracks full jump.

Cut Spike (Premium): Aims cross-court at opposite antenna when near net. Automatically evaluates enemy gaps and drops ball via Cut W-Tilt.

Line Shot: Aims straight down the line when standing near sidelines (1-5 studs).

Auto Serve: Mid-air hits with independent 14x10 grid aiming, auto-toss delay, serve tilt, power selectors, and line serve targeting.

Receives, Blocks, & Sets
Auto Receive: Modes: Bump, Soft Bump (speed-scaled release capped at 16 studs), Smart Bump (skips out-of-bounds balls via green/red ESP), and Set. Features Receive Magnet auto-walking via MoveTo.

Auto Block: Triggers near net. Modes: Block, Set Block (+50ms enemy set detection padding), and Net Fish (drops ball to your court via S-tilt).

Auto Set: Jumps, steers camera, and sets targeting Antennas, Sideways, or Teammates (predicts position 400ms ahead using velocity).

Auto Dive: Low-ball safety diving targeting Ball, Court, or Teammates with smooth rotation, animation lock, and a 0.5x-3x speed multiplier override.

Court Automation: Auto Play handles full court positioning and idle jitter-strafing. Auto Queue auto-joins matches, selects mode (Regular/Pro), team, and position slots. Auto Ability fires skills at 100% charge.

CHARACTER, PHYSICS, & VISUALS
Ping-Adaptive Timing: Smoothed ping tracking (85/15 EMA) automatically adjusts action windows.

Movement Bypasses: Glide Bypass offers camera-relative WASD air movement (speed 10-150). Aim Bypass frees mid-air rotation.

Modifications: Rate-limited WalkSpeed (1-100) and JumpPower (1-200) write overrides. Lowers personal gravity via a 1-100% slider.

Hitboxes: Instantiates sphere parts on CLIENT_BALL models. Smart Hitbox (Premium) swaps sizes dynamically for Block, Bump, Dive, Serve, Set, and Spike states.

Visual ESP: Features Ball ESP (closest highlight, neon trajectory beam, floor landing predictor cylinder) and Player ESP (team/opponent highlights, distance labels, and Blocker/Receiver/Jump roles mapping).

Aim & Zone Grids: Floor indicators for Spike Target, Smart Aim Area, Court boundaries, Cut Spike/Line Shot zones, and Serve target fields.

Directional Lines: Extends beams from enemy heads showing facing direction. Toggleable to Jump Only.

REWARDS, WEBHOOKS, & INTERNALS
Infinite Spins: Auto-claims ranked rewards on a 1.2s loop with rank gating (Bronze II to Silver III) and per-reward earning limits.

Quick Teleport: In-UI navigation to Lobby, Play, AFK, Shops, and Queues. Blocked during active matches.

Discord Webhooks: Sends match summary embeds (scores, MVP, streaks, comeback triggers) and rank updates. Features custom pings and a Panic Mode toggle
